title: Taiwanese Association of West Michigan 西密西根台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese Association of West Michigan (西密西根台灣同鄉會) is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization serving Taiwanese American communities across the United States. The chapter serves the Taiwanese American community in the West Michigan area and is listed under the TAA’s Mid-Western (美中西) regional grouping.
